archive_priority: Use archived daily record through its last date for each selected probe, including its exclusions; provisional records only after that date.
qa: Archive: A flag only and nonnegative. Provisional: all 288 five-minute intervals present, nonnegative, finite and blank flags. Do not sum cumulative storage values; use provider increment-corrected PRECIP_TOT.
additional_screen: For provisional days only, exclude any unflagged interval above 50 mm per 5 minutes or accepted daily total above 500 mm. This excludes one otherwise complete accepted day: UPLMET 2019-09-06, 9936 mm. Other screened days already failed completeness/flag checks. These are analysis QC screens, not model parameter changes.
dates: Station local timestamps retained. Interval-ending 00:00 assigned to prior day by subtracting 1 ns before daily grouping. No resampling into UTC. Daily boundaries versus GRIDMET may affect storm-day correspondence; multi-day totals also supplied.
forcing: Central run GRIDMET and generated wepp_cli included. Primary comparison uses area-weighted precipitation from every hillslope climate/_<topaz_id>.cli, weighted by watershed/hillslopes.parquet area. Model spatialmode Multiple.
statistic: Bias = 100 * (sum(forcing on accepted station dates) / sum(station on those dates) - 1). Point gauges compared with watershed forcing, not collocated GRIDMET pixels; do not interpret as a spatially unbiased basin precipitation estimate.
seasonal_sensitivity: Compare Aug 2020-Dec 2022 versus Aug 2023-Dec 2025, matching month/day with +3-year date offset and accepting only dates valid in both epochs. Not a test of fire causation.
limitations: Provisional flags do not establish gauge accuracy; VARMET has severe recent pre-epoch gaps and implausible undercatch/flat periods, so exclude it from primary conclusions.
Earlier epoch coverage differs among stations.
PRIMET precipitation has missing/flagged data during Jan 15-20 2024; no complete storm-total comparison for that gauge.
No WEPP settings or forcing were changed.
findings: Primary precipitation input is lower than PRIMET after the split and lower than UPLMET in both epochs.
Feb 20-25 2025 precipitation deficit is large and consistent across gauges on available dates.
Dec 16-21 2025 PRIMET and model precipitation totals agree; streamflow mismatch cannot be attributed solely to precipitation amount.
